items.q: his brother Horace, who would steal his arrangements, and sell them to Chick.

ctx.x: You see hundreds of hundreds of people on the floor, and they were bouncing in the beat, and it made you feel good. And -- well, Fletcher had always had this problem, when everything he played against Chick before, his brother Horace, who would steal his arrangements, and sell them to Chick.
